description:
Tracer Severus DTS – Electric Chopper Cruiser
Bold style meets serious power. The Severus DTS is a head-turning electric chopper bike that brings custom motorcycle attitude to the streets — with the range and muscle to back it up. With its stretched steel frame, chrome springer-style fork, and wide whitewall tires, this is a bike built to be seen and to perform.
Power & Performance
800W brushless gear motor paired with a 48V/20A controller for strong, confident acceleration
48V 20Ah battery delivers an estimated 40–65 mile range per charge
Thumb throttle for smooth, easy control
Colorful LCD display keeps speed, battery, and ride stats at a glance
Includes a US standard 2.0A smart charger
Built to Stop as Good as It Goes
180mm hydraulic rear brake with dual 180mm rotors for confident, reliable stopping power
Triple Tree Dual Springer GTS front fork smooths out bumps for a relaxed cruiser ride
Suspension saddle adds extra comfort on longer rides
Stance & Style
Chopper-inspired steel frame with a low, stretched-out profile
Fat, cushioned ride with Innova whitewall tires — 26"x3.0 front, 26"x4.0 rear
Matching 3" front / 4" rear one-piece FAT rims in white
Aluminum U-Type handlebar, aluminum pedals, and a heavy-duty aluminum kickstand
Neco H114 headset for tight, precise steering
Fit & Capacity
Recommended for riders 5'4" to 6'3"
400 lb max payload capacity
Why You'll Love It
The Severus DTS isn't just about looks — it's a genuine cruiser built for real miles, with the battery capacity, motor power, and braking performance to handle everything from neighborhood cruising to longer weekend rides. Whether you're commuting in style or just want to turn heads at the boardwalk, this chopper e-bike delivers.
